name: valheim-thunderstore
description: Valheim dedicated server with Thunderstore mod support. - Installs mods (and their dependencies) straight from thunderstore.io: list them by name or paste an r2modman / Thunderstore Mod Manager profile code. - Keeps Valheim and your mods up to date automatically, waiting until nobody is online before restarting. - Lets you choose the world seed, difficulty preset and world modifiers for new worlds. - Backs up the world before every restart and saves cleanly on stop. First start downloads about 1 GB of server files, so give it a few minutes. Forward UDP 2456-2457 on your router to play over the internet.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Worlds (saves/), backups, mod configs (bepinex-config/), your own plugins (custom-plugins/) and logs.

paths.name: Server files
paths.description: Valheim server files, BepInEx and installed mods. Can be deleted; everything here is re-downloaded.

ports.name: Game port
ports.description: Valheim game port. Keep host and container port the same as SERVER_PORT.

ports.name: Query port
ports.description: Steam query port (game port + 1). Used for the server browser and the player count.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: World name
variables.description: World to load or create (letters and numbers, no spaces recommended). Changing it starts a new world; the old one stays in saves/.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: At least 5 characters, and must not be part of the server name.

variables.name: World seed
variables.description: Seed for a NEW world (1-10 characters, e.g. HHcLC5acQt). Leave empty for random. Has no effect on a world that already exists.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: List the server in the in-game community server browser.

variables.name: Crossplay
variables.description: Allow Xbox / Microsoft Store players (uses PlayFab; the player count for idle updates is not available with crossplay).

variables.name: Admins
variables.description: SteamID64s of admins, separated by commas. Leave empty to manage saves/adminlist.txt yourself.

variables.name: Mods
variables.description: Thunderstore mods, separated by commas: Author-ModName (always latest), Author-ModName-1.2.3 (pinned) or the mod's thunderstore.io link. Dependencies and BepInEx are installed automatically. Example: ValheimModding-Jotunn, Azumatt-AzuCraftyBoxes

variables.name: Profile code
variables.description: Optional. In r2modman or Thunderstore Mod Manager: Settings, Profile, Export profile as code. Installs the same mods as your client profile (saved locally, so it keeps working after the code expires).

variables.name: Exclude mods
variables.description: Mods never to install, e.g. client-only UI mods from your profile. Same format as Mods.

variables.name: Pin profile versions
variables.description: true = keep the exact mod versions from the profile instead of updating them.

variables.name: Import profile configs
variables.description: Copy config files from the profile code (only files you don't already have).

variables.name: Always install BepInEx
variables.description: Install BepInEx even with no Thunderstore mods. Happens automatically when custom-plugins/ has files.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Check for Valheim and mod updates in the background and restart to apply them. Updates are always applied when the container starts.

variables.name: Update Valheim
variables.description: Include Valheim itself in background updates.

variables.name: Update mods
variables.description: Include Thunderstore mods in background updates.

variables.name: Update check interval
variables.description: Minutes between update checks.

variables.name: Only update when empty
variables.description: Wait until no players are online before restarting for an update.

variables.name: Max wait for empty server
variables.description: Minutes to wait for an empty server before restarting anyway (0 = wait forever).

variables.name: Steam branch
variables.description: Valheim branch, e.g. public or public-test.

variables.name: Steam branch password
variables.description: Password for a protected branch (public-test uses yesimadebackups).

variables.name: Difficulty preset
variables.description: Optional: normal, casual, easy, hard, hardcore, immersive or hammer.

variables.name: World modifiers
variables.description: Optional, comma separated name:value. combat (veryeasy-veryhard), deathpenalty (casual-hardcore), resources (muchless-most), raids (none-muchmore), portals (casual, hard, veryhard). Example: combat:hard, raids:none

variables.name: World keys
variables.description: Optional, comma separated: nomap, playerevents, passivemobs, nobuildcost, fire, teleportall

variables.name: Backup on restart
variables.description: Save a .tar.gz of the world to backups/ before every start.

variables.name: Backups to keep
variables.description: Number of world backups to keep.

variables.name: Server port
variables.description: Only change together with both port mappings (host and container) above.

variables.name: Extra server arguments
variables.description: Passed straight to valheim_server, e.g. -saveinterval 600 -backups 4

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID files are owned by (99 = nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID files are owned by (100 = users).

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone for logs and backup names.
